spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Rājagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the squirrels’ feeding ground.
Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho āyasmantaṁ sāriputtaṁ bhagavā etadavoca: Then in the late afternoon, Sāriputta came out of retreat and went to the Buddha.
The Buddha said to him, Puna caparaṁ, sāriputta, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṁ: Furthermore, a mendicant should reflect: ‘pahīnā nu kho me pañca nīvaraṇā’ti?

Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṁ jānāti: But suppose that, upon checking, a mendicant knows that ‘pahīnā kho me pañca nīvaraṇā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṁ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
